text_a: The receiving party agrees to protect proprietary confidential information with reasonable care for a duration of five (5) years.
text_b: Recipient must safeguard proprietary trade secrets using at least reasonable diligence for five years from disclosure.

text_a: Vendor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Customer against any third-party claims arising from intellectual property infringement.
text_b: Customer shall indemnify Vendor for any costs incurred from third-party IP infringement lawsuits.

text_a: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict of law principles.
text_b: All disputes arising hereunder shall be adjudicated in accordance with Delaware state legislation.

text_a: Either party may terminate this agreement with thirty (30) days written notice to the other party.
text_b: Agreement may be cancelled by either party upon delivering 30 days prior written notification.

text_a: Under no circumstances shall either party's aggregate liability exceed the total fees paid in the preceding twelve (12) months.
text_b: Liability shall be uncapped and unlimited for any gross negligence or willful misconduct.

text_a: Provider guarantees monthly service availability uptime of at least 99.95%, excluding scheduled maintenance.
text_b: The monthly cloud uptime commitment is 99.95%, not counting planned maintenance windows.

text_a: Data Processor shall process personal data solely in compliance with GDPR and customer's documented instructions.
text_b: Vendor reserves the right to commercialize anonymized customer telemetry data without consent.

text_a: All invoices are due and payable within thirty (30) calendar days from receipt by Customer.
text_b: Net 30 payment schedule applies to all submitted billing statements.

text_a: Neither party shall solicit or hire employees of the other party during the term and for one year thereafter.
text_b: Customer agrees not to recruit Vendor personnel during active engagement and for 12 months post-termination.

text_a: Neither party shall be liable for delays caused by acts of God, war, pandemic, or government embargo.
text_b: Performance failure resulting from unforeseeable natural catastrophes or armed conflict shall be excused.

text_a: Software is provided as-is without warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose.
text_b: Vendor guarantees that software shall operate completely error-free and bug-free at all times.

text_a: Customer may audit Vendor's security records once per year with ten (10) business days prior written notice.
text_b: Annual security compliance reviews are permitted upon providing 10 working days advance notice.

text_a: If any provision is found invalid, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.
text_b: Should a court invalidate one clause, all other contractual stipulations continue uninterrupted.

text_a: Vendor shall not delegate or subcontract duties without Customer's prior written authorization.
text_b: Vendor is freely entitled to outsource execution to unvetted third parties without notice.

text_a: No modification of this agreement shall be valid unless executed in writing signed by authorized representatives.
text_b: Amendments require mutual written agreement executed by signatories of both parties.

text_a: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence.
text_b: General liability policy with coverage minimum of two million dollars must be preserved by Vendor.

text_a: All custom deliverables developed under this SOW shall be deemed work-for-hire and owned exclusively by Customer.
text_b: Vendor retains all copyright and patent ownership in deliverables created for Customer.

text_a: Parties shall attempt informal mediation for thirty (30) days prior to initiating formal binding arbitration.
text_b: A mandatory 30-day good faith mediation step must precede any submission to arbitration tribunals.

text_a: Each party agrees to comply with all applicable United States export control and economic sanction regulations.
text_b: Compliance with US export management guidelines and international trade sanctions is compulsory.

text_a: This document constitutes the entire understanding between the parties, superseding all prior oral or written discussions.
text_b: This contract represents the complete mutual agreement, replacing all preceding negotiations and promises.
